description: Labels for process-scoped, immutable loaded backend policy metadata. Edge v0.9.11 is published with verified upstream distribution; this canonical contracts tag/publication remains pending. Mode lists describe the final evaluation stage, not unconditional effective allows. Classifier meaning changes require versioned coordination.

provenance.note: Transcribed GET /backend-egress-policy labels, scope limits, v1 classifier and conservative guarantee rule; no raw CIDRs or credentials.

public_only_guaranteed_rule: True exactly when mode=public and allow_cidr_overrides_present=false; deny overrides only restrict. Even a wholly public undisclosed allow list yields false. The dangerous-range flag alone does not certify public-only egress.
consumer_rule: For public-only publication, recognize the complete version/classification/vocabulary, match the requested namespace, require local-data-plane and public_only_guaranteed=true, and check every serving DP after replacement/restart. Missing/unknown values or authorization failure block publication. CP admission-only metadata never attests its DPs.
